__help.shortcuts__:
GENERAL COMMANDS

Alt+1: go to the URL tab.
Alt+2: go to the YouTube Search tab.
Alt+3: go to the Channels and playlists tab.
Alt+D: download only the focused item.
Alt+R: play only the focused item.
Alt+I: information for the focused item.
Alt+C: copy the URL of the focused item.
Alt+L: clear the search box.
Ctrl+Shift+D: download marked videos in Channels and playlists.
Ctrl+L: go to the URL field.
Ctrl+B: go to search.
Ctrl+O: select folder.
Ctrl+I: URL information.
Ctrl+H: view history.
Ctrl+K or Escape: cancel download.
Ctrl+Q: exit.

IN CHANNELS AND PLAYLISTS

Space: mark or unmark a video for multiple download.
Enter: open actions for the focused channel, playlist or video.
Alt+R: play the focused video.
Alt+D: download the focused video.
Alt+I: information for the focused video.
Alt+C: copy the URL of the focused video.
Alt+L: clear the channel or playlist search.
Ctrl+Shift+D: download marked videos.

INTERNAL PLAYER

1: rewind.
2: pause or continue.
3: fast forward.
4: stop.
5: decrease speed.
6: increase speed.
7: decrease volume.
8: increase volume.
9: say current position.
0: say total duration.
